address: Historiador Juan Torres Fontes 20, Murcia, 30011, Spain
bio: This Japanese restaurant, with a somewhat austere appearance and an impressive bar, has an uncompromising and full focus on Asian cuisine, with a menu featuring the usual array of raw options complemented by a full repertoires of hot dishes which are well crafted and presented. We can recommend the Omakase surprise menu, prepared using the best ingredients available on the day....
